sentence: Shows who owes and who gets back for a group's shared expenses, then works out the fewest payments to settle everyone and lets people mark each one sent.
use_when: A group trip or outing has several shared costs and someone needs to work out who owes what
People want a short list of payments to square up after expenses paid by different people
Members need to add an expense and then mark payments as sent or received
dont_use_when: Splitting a single bill once at a table with uneven item choices
Voting or polling the group on a decision
Tracking a long-running shared budget or recurring household bills over months
